raw_comment:
I notice that the most intense areas of the drought are concentrated in the Northwest and Southwest, with a little area in the Northeast. The area with the least drought is Florida. I also notice that Texas has the most diversity because it has all the types of severity even though it’s only one state. 
	I wonder how Texas is able to have exceptional drought as well as no drought at all in the same general area. I also wonder what factors cause the areas that are experiencing exceptional drought to become that way. Additionally, because most of the more severe drought is concentrated in the same area, I wonder why that little area in the Northeast has exceptional drought when most of the area around it is moderate or abnormally dry. 
	This relates to me and my community because the map shows Michigan experiencing a severe/moderate drought, which could affect me personally. Fields need water to thrive, so if we are experiencing a severe drought, farms in Michigan may struggle to yield crops. Also, lots of fruits and vegetables my family buys at the store come from other states, so if those states are experiencing a drought then it might affect what I can buy at the store. 
Headline: Is America Drying Up?
